'''Incomplete article.''' The Japanese card face is shown. Fields awaiting verification are marked below.

== Title ==
<span lang="ja">帝国を担う背</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-272o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：「ベイダー」、「ターキン」、「モッティ」、「タッグ」のいずれかがロストした場合に使い、２フォース消費してロストデッキから取り戻す。２：４フォース消費して自分のリザーブ・デッキの中から「ベイダー」、「ターキン」、「モッティ」、「タッグ」を探して手札に入れる。その後でデッキをシャッフルし、カットすること。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「今後帝国に刃向かおうとする星系は一つもなくなる。」</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' The Back That Bears the Empire.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. 1. When Vader, Tarkin, Motti, or Tagge is lost, use 2 Force to retrieve that card from your Lost Pile. 2. Use 4 Force to search your Reserve Deck for Vader, Tarkin, Motti, or Tagge and take the card into hand. Then shuffle and cut the deck.

'''Lore:''' “There will no longer be a single system willing to defy the Empire.”

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 3

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
